title: Morph rewrite drops auth triggers during cutover
summary: Cloudron can finish the Structure morph-map cutover: role and permission pivots rewrite from the previous user class name to the stable user alias without the authorization guard blocking the update.
changes: Drop authorization compatibility triggers for the morph FQCN rewrite window, then reinstall them with the user alias.
Keep audit, attachment, notification, and Spatie pivot rewrites in the same migration after triggers are suspended.
Cover the provenanced model_has_roles rewrite path with a Structure layout regression test.
version_rationale: Patch on v0.37.x: deploy cutover fix only, with no change to product behaviour, URLs, or permission strings after migrate.
validation: php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
Cloudron workflow_dispatch with app_version from VERSION after merge; live /healthz and /change-log confirm the deployed version.
known_limitations: Triggers are absent only for the brief rewrite window inside this migration; they are reinstalled before activation continues.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. If this migration already completed, morph aliases remain; restore from the pre-deployment Cloudron backup only if a database rollback is required.
provenance: Morph rewrite auth-trigger suspend for issue #302, pull request #303.
